name: Shiori
message: "We're here. I take it you want to get some more info from that supermarket lady?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm honestly not great with her... but let's set that aside."

name: Shiori
message: "She always says the same things, word for word."

name: Shiori
message: "Once she sees me, she'll probably ask why I'm not in school again, then start talking about how so-and-so's husband is cheating."

name: Shiori
message: "So even if we ask about that girl, I think she'll just say the exact same things again."

name: Shiori
message: "If we're going to get anything out of her, we need new info. Give her something different to latch onto, so she'll start talking about something else."

name: Shiori
message: "She blows things out of proportion to the point it stops being believable, but she does drop unexpected bits sometimes, so we can't just write her off."

name: Shiori
message: "But the problem is, once she gets a hold of you, you'll be stuck for ages..."

name: Shiori
message: "So if we're going to talk to her, let's only do it when we're sure we can get something new out of her."

name: Shiori
message: "...I should've said so before we came here. I'm sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, let's get out of here before she notices us."

name: Shiori
message: "We're back, but we don't really have any business here."

name: Shiori
message: "Now, before she catches us—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey, you two!"

name: Shiori
message: "Let's get out of here!"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh? Look, over there."

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it... she did say she was out shopping."

name: Shiori
message: "I know this is a rude way of putting it, but... looking at her from afar, she really does look like an ordinary, kind mother."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "My, if it isn't Uribayashi-san! Out shopping? What are you making for dinner?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... she got caught..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh dear, you're still doing that? Walking around with a doll in a stroller..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wha—?! Ah...! Sh-She said it...!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Doing that won't bring your child back, you know? It's high time you stopped messing around and faced reality—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "H-Hey! Where are you going?!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "The nerve! She ignored me again!"

name: Shiori
message: "She just bowed and ignored her... Incredible!"

name: Shiori
message: "—Okay, I was impressed for a second there, but I guess that wasn't it."

name: Shiori
message: "It looks like she really can see ghosts... but she probably can't hear them."

name: Shiori
message: "Something felt off when we met earlier, too. I think my words weren't reaching her."

name: Shiori
message: "Remember what I told you when we first met? There are people who can see me, but you're the only one I've ever been able to speak with."

name: Shiori
message: "She's probably one of those who can only see. Plus... I don't think she can tell the living from the dead."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why she bowed when that lady approached her... but I'm glad she couldn't hear her. I'm... really not good with that ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "How could someone be so insensitive?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Ah! You! Why aren't you in school?!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Oh no. She's locked onto us."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What are you doing here at this hour?! What about school?! You've got some nerve loitering around here during school hours! Don't blame me if the police pick you up!"

name: Shiori
message: "Umm... Ma'am, was that woman just now... Uribayashi-san? I-Is she a friend?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What? Of course not! I go out of my way to reach out to her, but that girl ignores me every single time!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Her name's Rina-chan. I've always been nice to her, you know? But she's always been trouble."

name: Shiori
message: "Trouble, you say?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, she's done it before, that girl! Getting pregnant when she was a student!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And you know what? The guy ran off on her, but that irresponsible girl still insisted on giving birth."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And in the end, what? She miscarried. Good. Whether it was the stress or the shock of being dumped, who knows? Either way, she wouldn't have been able to raise that kid."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "That's when she went off the rails. Nothing but problems after that. She started snatching up kids left and right."

name: Shiori
message: "She... kidnapped them?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Whenever she spots a little kid, she says it's her child and tries to take them away. Again and again. What, you didn't know? It's common knowledge around here."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I mean, you saw *that*, didn't you? That doll in the stroller. She thinks it's her kid."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "That's the only thing that managed to calm her down. Unsettling, isn't it? She finally stopped bothering people, but that doesn't make it any less wrong, don't you think?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "The Uribayashi family's just full of problems. She wouldn't have ended up like that otherwise."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yup, they got their just desserts. This world isn't all sunshine, you know? Funny how things work out."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You'd best keep an eye on her. You'll never know when she'll cause trouble again she absolutely will she's only settled down for now..."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go. I don't want to hear any more of this."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I'm sure she'll just snag another man and get dumped again. Girls like her always repeat the same mistakes—"

name: Shiori
message: "...Phew. We should be safe now."

name: Shiori
message: "Honestly... I don't know how she can talk like that."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I brought up the topic too, so I guess I'm partly to blame."

name: Shiori
message: "I froze when she mentioned the kidnapping... It was like... something in my mind connected it to the case."

name: Shiori
message: "But... if those kidnappings—no, attempted kidnappings—were the result of a psychological issue..."

name: Shiori
message: "Then Girl A, who was seen with one of the victims, would have nothing to do with it."

name: Shiori
message: "...No, I shouldn't assume the mother... Uribayashi Rina—was it?—is Girl A."

name: Shiori
message: "I do want to hear her side, but... it isn't something we should bring up. And since she can't hear me, you'd have to be the one to ask..."

name: Shiori
message: "We shouldn't get too involved with Uribayashi-san. It doesn't feel right prying into her life just because of our circumstances."

name: Shiori
message: "And on top of that, I'd even end up making you do the prying for me. I can't let that happen."

name: Shiori
message: "For now, let's just keep it in mind as a possibility. Girl A might even be completely unrelated to the case."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, shall we?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait. Are you planning to go to the supermarket?"

name: Shiori
message: "I... really don't want to see that lady anymore today."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's just head back for today, okay?"
